title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively removing some features from the model.

title: Effect of LASSO on Bias
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, it tends to increase the bias of the model because it restricts the model's flexibility by shrinking some coefficients to zero.

title: Effect of LASSO on Variance
text: LASSO regularization can decrease the variance of the model by reducing the complexity of the model, as it effectively reduces the number of features.

title: Effect of LASSO on MSE
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) on training data might increase due to the added bias, but the MSE on held-out test data might decrease due to reduced variance and overfitting.
